svg.title: What your business gains from the Decision Audit
svg.desc: Example data: 357 missing fields found on the example laptop shelf (screen size 80, memory 60, processor 162, storage 55). 15 of 32 shopper requirements need screen size, so it ranks first.

div.p: Discover missing product attributes that make it difficult for shoppers to compare products and find the right fit.
